newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BHP shares edge higher after steel shake-up.
newsitem.headline: BHP shares edge higher after steel shake-up.

text.p: Shares in The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP) edged higher on Tuesday after it announced it would close its Newcastle steelworks as part of a restructure of the steel business.
BHP shares were seven cents higher at A$17.45 at 0030 GMT (10.30 a.m.), minutes after the announcement.
But one BHP analyst, who had yet to see the full details of the announcement, was guarded in his reaction.
"I think what they need on the back of this is a five percent re-rating, not a five cent re-rating," said the analyst, who declined to be identified.
The analyst was cautious about BHP Steel's statement that it was committed to further international expansion.
"I think that's a direction that needs precise justification," the analyst said.
"What BHP needs from this is a big win and a big vote of confidence in the management and, have they delivered that?..The jury is still out."
